evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone search capability; no other backlog story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires the existence of a user profile to base search on, which is not provided by this story and is only meaningful if profile-based capabilities exist elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having user profiles/behavior data to compute similarity between users.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Defines a self-contained similarity search given an input video; no explicit prerequisite story is required.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Can be delivered as a search feature assuming metadata/tags exist in the system; no specific other story is stated as required first.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained ingestion requirement; it provides foundational data rather than depending on another story.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires videos to be segmented into segments before thumbnail sequences of segments can be shown.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Depends on having video segments available (segmentation) and similarity computation; segmentation is explicitly covered elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Depends on the existence of segments (and their perceptual features) to compare; segmentation is a prerequisite capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Inherently requires user profiles to exist and be comparable; profile-based search is captured in another story.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone recommendation feature using location and news-event relevance; no explicit prerequisite story is required.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained feature: person identification plus information retrieval; no other story is a stated prerequisite.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
